simulation_run.decision: simulate is the owned orchestration use case; its command/request/result and authored output bundle are one removable simulation slice.

pinned_connectome.decision: Two pinned immutable input files are read into ordered network values; no independent create/update/delete service or endpoint exists. The qualification input audit consumes a snapshot, not a second persistence owner.

experiment_stimulus.decision: Experiment definitions and seeded event tapes are simulation inputs and stored run artifacts; no independent event-tape service or endpoint is present.

simulation_spike_output.decision: Simulation authors its spike and report bundle. Comparison imports file observations as inputs and does not become an owner of the producing run.

comparison_report.decision: compare owns the comparison request, scoring and its JSON/CSV output. Read-only imported spike snapshots are input values rather than foreign database queries.

qualification_case.decision: qualify/parity-case orchestration owns the frozen scientific gate and its result evidence. Matrix summaries and observed native/tape/queue files are evidence of that use case.

reference_build_execution.decision: The current qualification case builds one frozen reference producer and runs it in fresh scoped processes. No independent lifecycle/reuse policy/service is implemented; build/read/run mechanics and retained artifacts are a non-independent runtime child of qualification_case. Concrete role/injection/lifetime and scientific reuse obligations remain separate debt.

native_execution_state.decision: Native network/layout/state implement the simulation run and have no independent public operation service. Qualification consumes actual evidence through its assigned opaque-session boundary. Device representation, allocation/evaluation/stream lifetime, mutable observations and complete adoption qualification remain separate debt.

flywire_neuron.decision: Public connectome, experiment, file-spike fields and Metrics scalar keys use owned nominal brands. Mapped raster comparison/pooling contracts use FlyWire specialization. Generic report rows still erase FlyWire identity; lawful conversion origins remain unproved.

neuron_row.decision: Connectome, stimulus, spike-event and NetworkCase selector fields use owned nominal brands. Row-space coordinate validation uses its own raster specialization. Observation maps and reduction selectors remain primitive; lawful origins remain unproved.

edge_row.decision: Grouping and bucket fields distinguish original and padded edge brands. Due-event contracts retain primitive original-edge positions; reduction leaves retain primitive padded-edge slots with their occupancy masks.

trial.decision: Stimulus, session, case, spike-event contracts and Metrics grouping keys use owned trial brands. Canonical singleton keys and batch-difference records use TrialId while local array positions remain coordinates. Positional artifact provenance, lawful origins and joint stimulus identity remain unproved.

experiment_name.decision: The owned closed Literal names five frozen experiments; its strict-native identity/substitution checking still needs the resolver layer.

parity_case.decision: The frozen dataclass composes experiment, horizon and trial identity; exact required-case membership remains a scientific rule.

reference_identity.decision: ReferenceProducerDigest is a qualification-owned NewType over str, returned by create without changing canonical record encoding or digest bytes. Native typed consumers reject primitives and foreign brands; explicit rebranding, lawful producer/conversion-site, lifetime and complete structural analysis remain COV002. This producer key is not an executable seal, successful-run proof or cache-reuse eligibility.

database.decision: All retained Python/stub files were parsed and their imports/declarations/storage calls reviewed. Application persistence is CSV/Parquet/NumPy/JSON/tape and generated scientific process files; no database driver, ORM, schema, SQL, table migration or database endpoint is defined. The pre-commit SQLite cache belongs to the external tool lifecycle, not an application table.

http_endpoints.decision: Startup is argparse command dispatch. The Brian2 subprocess stdout stream is an external observation protocol, not an HTTP endpoint; no web framework/router/server or endpoint contract exists in the source inventory.

limitations: ANALYSIS FAILED (COV002): This registry and loader are not the complete 37-rule analyzer.
Declaration fingerprints cover inventory.py named functions/classes/module and class assignments, including duplicate overload records; they do not classify every use or effect.

Binding fingerprints are conservative reviewed AST-binding-set tripwires for imports, parameters, stored/deleted names and attributes, global/nonlocal, exception and match names. They do not establish resolved identity, lambda/comprehension scope, capture ownership, call targets, alias flow or effect purity.

Host NumPy arrays are numeric data rather than collaborator implementations. Writable aliases inside frozen records remain unresolved; only ReductionRow has detached immutable-byte evidence in the retained qualification.

MLX device arrays/State/Layout and concrete execution callbacks are not neutral public exports. Representation, lifecycle, array-library effects and scientific admissibility are not waived or changed.

No implicit public permission is granted by Python visibility, package roots or re-exported imports. Only exact registered types/ports and their named fields/properties are public neutral contracts; foreign direct pure-rule calls need separate contract analysis.

The five current source roots are fully discovered without generated/vendor exclusions. Historical executed records were removed under the explicit default-deletion instruction; four active reference/oracle source files remain hash-frozen.

Handwritten Brian2/PyArrow stubs stay first-party checked contract inputs. Adapted Brian2/PyTorch references have exact local and upstream provenance and retain scientific scope; none has a generated-code exemption.

Reference-build/execution and native execution-state belong to their existing qualification-case/simulation-run workflows as storage-only runtime children. Source ownership is resolved; concrete accesses, lifecycle/representation/alias effects, scientific adoption and primitive identifier contracts remain separate findings or COV002 coverage gaps.

Production declaration role overrides record existing mixed-role/owner responsibilities; they do not authorize incompatible co-location or effect calls. Full placement, graph, call, resource and control-flow checks are not implemented here.

findings.message: The reviewed local ports depend on concrete core.State, core.StepTrace and MLX arrays; Compiler and Factory also reach core.Network and Advance through Execution. Advance is excluded from neutral public exports, so this is DEP004 contract dependence rather than a ROLE006 public-contract leak.

The frozen adapted scientific reference contains framework implementation and model rules. Preserve it as analyzed handwritten reference source; relocation or exact reviewed deviation remains separate.
